original_page_visual_review.scope: Entire actual Chinese page: all prose, inline/display mathematics, original program comments/fields/timings, tables, algorithm updates and footnote where present.

bilingual_review.scope: Actual corresponding English page images inspected, prose and every formula/program/table field compared. This is not inferred from a fixed pagination offset or OCR agreement.
bilingual_review.qualification: Convergence and historical references not independently reproved; finite numerical/algorithm checks separately described.

rendered_proof.qualification: Independent eight-page KaTeX/footnote proof with current public math-display CSS; not final full-volume or site acceptance.
